name: AudioIssue
description: A source-timestamped capture, signal, provider, or upload finding detected during a session

kind.description: Issue kind: legacy clipping or silence, leading_silence, trailing_silence, possible_clipping, possible_pop_click, possible_distortion, source signal, sharing, recorder, upload, or transcription finding

timestamp_ms.description: Full-session source timestamp where the finding starts, including valid silence and shared-track-end positions

end_timestamp_ms.description: Optional full-session source timestamp where the finding ends

source.description: Finding source: vad, provider, or recorder

possible.description: True when a local signal heuristic is only a possible finding, not a confirmed acoustic cause

confidence.description: Optional provider or signal confidence from zero to one
